info.title: sandbox-broker
info.description: Authenticated control API for hardened, single-tenant Docker sandboxes. Requests carry a fixed option set: the API never accepts an image, bind mount, capability, device, user or privileged flag.

get.description: Unauthenticated. Reports process liveness only, never Docker internals.
Authenticated. Verifies Docker connectivity, required images, and the configured workspace quota mode.

post.description: Repeating a request with the same idempotencyKey and identical configuration returns the existing sandbox. A conflicting configuration returns 409.

200.description: Existing sandbox for this idempotency key.

409.description: Idempotency key reused with a different configuration.

422.description: Requested policy is not supported by this broker version.
